d: BEST GENSHIN IMPACT SKINS 40 | #genshinimpact #genshin #геншинимпакт #геншин Genshin Impact — это масштабная приключенческая ролевая игра с открытым миром и элементами гача, разработанная китайской студией HoYoverse (ранее известной как miHoYo) и завоевавшая многомиллионную аудиторию по всему миру с момента своего релиза в 2020 году. Действие игры разворачивается в сказочном фэнтезийном мире под названием Тейват, состоящем из семи уникальных королевств, каждое из которых находится под покровительством своего Архонта — божества, олицетворяющего одну из семи стихий: Анемо (ветер), Гео (землю), Электро (электричество), Дендро (природу), Гидро (воду), Пиро (огонь) и Крио (лёд). Завязка сюжета начинается с того, что главный герой, известный как Путешественник или Путешественница, вместе со своим близнецом путешествовал между мирами, но столкнулся с таинственной безымянной богиней, которая разлучила родных людей, лишила их сил и запечатала в Тейвате. Проснувшись спустя сотни лет, главный герой встречает крошечную и жизнерадостную спутницу по имени Паймон, которая становится его гидом, и вместе они отправляются в грандиозное странствие по всем регионам, чтобы вернуть утраченного близнеца и разгадать секреты этого загадочного мира. В процессе своего путешествия игрок посещает невероятно разнообразные земли: свободолюбивый Мондштадт, вдохновлённый средневековой Европой; величественный и контрастный Ли Юэ, созданный на основе древнекитайской культуры и философии; изолированную и суровую островную Инадзуму с эстетикой феодальной Японии; утопающий в джунглях и пустынях Сумеру, впитавший мотивы Южной Азии и Ближнего Востока; прогрессивный и изысканный Фонтейн, выполненный в стиле стимпанка и Прекрасной эпохи Франции, а также другие развивающиеся регионы Тейвата. Повествование отличается огромной глубиной и проработанностью лора, заложенного не только в эпических Заданиях Архонтов и личных историях персонажей, но и в описаниях предметов, прочитанных книгах, древних фресках и руинах, что постепенно открывает перед игроком мрачную историю павшей цивилизации Каэнри'ах и загадочный небесный порядок Селестии. Основой игрового процесса является свобода исследования огромного бесшовного мира и динамичная боевая система, завязанная на элементальном взаимодействии. Игроки могут беспрепятственно перемещаться по живописным локациям, карабкаться по отвесным скалам, парить на планере, плавать, погружаться под воду и решать сотни уникальных головоломок, скрывающих ценные сокровища и тайники. Боевая система строится на создании отряда из четырёх персонажей, между которыми можно мгновенно переключаться прямо во время сражения. Главная фишка боёв — элементальные реакции: наложение одной стихии на другую вызывает мощные визуальные и боевые эффекты, такие как Пар, Таяние, Заморозка, Перегрузка, Раздувание, Кристаллизация, а также сложнейшие Дендро-реакции вроде Бутонизации и Стимуляции. Это побуждает постоянно экспериментировать с составом команды, подбирая героев с синергирующими способностями для эффективного прохождения испытаний, витых бездн и битв с гигантскими боссами. Визуально Genshin Impact выполнена в сказочном аниме-стиле с высочайшим уровнем детализации, динамичной сменой времени суток и реалистичными погодными условиями, создающими невероятно атмосферную картинку. Особого упоминания заслуживает музыкальное сопровождение, созданное внутренней студией HOYO-MiX и записанное крупнейшими мировыми симфоническими оркестрами. Музыка в игре глубоко отражает культурные особенности каждого региона благодаря гармоничному сочетанию классических симфонических инструментов и аутентичных народных мотивов разных стран мира. Игра распространяется по бесплатной модели Free-to-Play и получает масштабные контентные обновления каждые шесть недель, которые постоянно добавляют новые территории, персонажей, сюжетные главы и временные события.

d: Embers of the Uncrowned is a newly announced dark-fantasy MMORPG from Nexon that leans heavily into Diablo-style isometric combat, combining fast, skill-based action with brutal, gore-filled visuals. Set on a war-torn continent devastated by a massive elven invasion, the game puts you in the role of the last heir to a fallen noble house, fighting to reclaim your land and restore your legacy. (Gematsu) Combat is designed to be both fast and tactical, with multiple distinct classes like the Spectral Blade, Executioner, and Stormbringer, each offering unique abilities and playstyles. You’ll also recruit companions and team up with other players to take on massive bosses, raids, and large-scale PvE threats that require coordination and strategy. (Gematsu) Beyond combat, the game features settlement building and progression systems, letting you grow your domain from a small camp into a thriving city as you liberate regions and expand your influence. With deep customization, co-op gameplay, and a grim narrative, Embers of the Uncrowned aims to deliver a brutal, modern take on the MMORPG formula. hell nah, ts is above my paygrade 👮❌ Rehaunted is a psychological detective horror game where you investigate a brutal crime scene inside a house full of disturbing evidence, hidden secrets, and contradictions. You play as detective Connor Raines, called to what looks like a straightforward case: a young woman found dead in her home. But the deeper you dig, the more the evidence contradicts itself, blood traces, fingerprints, hidden recordings, and personal belongings slowly revealing a much darker story. Use your UV flashlight, camera, magnifier, and evidence board to uncover clues invisible to the naked eye, stay in radio contact with another detective through branching dialogue, and connect the evidence to build your own conclusions. The game never directly tells you the answers. The house feels abandoned, but it never feels empty. A 2 to 3 hour experience. 🎮 Game: Rehaunted 🎯 Genre: Psychological Detective Horror / Investigation 👥 Players: Single-player 💻 Platform: PC (Steam) 🛠️ Developer: Cauchemar 📅 Release Date: Q3 2026 #indiegame #newgame #horrorgames #gameplay #steamgames

d: I came across another terrifying video showing what locals believe to be a Pocong — one of the scariest ghosts in Indonesian and Malaysian folklore. The Pocong is said to be the restless spirit of someone whose burial shroud was never untied after death. In Islamic tradition, the body is wrapped tightly in white cloth, and if the ties at the head or feet aren’t released after 40 days, the soul can’t move on. That’s when the Pocong rises… hopping from grave to grave, its face pale and eyes sunken, searching for someone to help free it — or to take revenge. Some say it smells like rotting flowers before it appears. Others claim you’ll hear a faint hopping sound outside your window before it shows itself. Whether this clip is real or fake, there’s something unsettling about how it moves… Do you think this video caught a real Pocong or something else entirely? 👀 #fyp #scary #creepy #horrortok #scarytiktoks

d: Kuntilanak adalah sebutan untuk hantu perempuan yang sangat populer dalam di Indonesia, khususnya di daerah Jawa dan sebagian besar daerah di Indonesia. Dalam berbagai cerita, kuntilanak digambarkan sebagai roh wanita yang meninggal saat melahirkan atau dalam kondisi hamil, dan seringkali digambarkan sebagai sosok yang pendendam dan mengganggu manusia. Kuntilanak seringkali dikaitkan dengan berbagai mitos dan cerita horor, seperti sosok yang memiliki suara tertawa melengking yang menyeramkan, atau sosok yang sering muncul di area yang sunyi dan gelap. Selain itu, dalam beberapa cerita, kuntilanak juga digambarkan sebagai sosok yang bisa menampakkan wujud fisik, seperti sosok wanita dengan pakaian putih dan rambut panjang yang berantakan. Asal-usul kuntilanak sangat bervariasi, namun umumnya diyakini bahwa kuntilanak adalah roh wanita yang meninggal karena melahirkan atau keguguran dan tidak bisa tenang setelah kematiannya.Ada yang punya pengalaman mistis sama sosok satu ini👀 #Viralmedia #Trendsmedia #Horror #HorrrorVideos #Dagelanmistis #Mistismedia #Creepy #Ceritamistis #Ceritaseram
h: viralmedia, trendsmedia, horror, horrrorvideos, dagelanmistis, mistismedia, creepy, ceritamistis, ceritaseram
zh: Kuntilanak 是印尼非常流行的女性鬼魂称谓，尤其在爪哇及大部分地区。通常被认为是死于分娩或怀孕的女鬼，常被描绘成心怀怨恨、骚扰人类的形象，与多种恐怖传说相关，如发出尖锐可怕的笑声，或出现在偏僻黑暗之地。也有说法称其能显现物理形态，如穿着白衣、长发凌乱的女人。起源说法不一，但普遍认为其死后无法安息。有人跟这个鬼魂有过灵异经历吗👀

d: ” สายที่1ก็หลอนสะแล้ว“โครตน่ากลัว‼️                “เรื่องนี้”ปรีชา“นายเป็นผีโคตรงี่เง่าเลยครับ‼️😤 ฟังจบแล้วรู้สึกโกรธผีมากผีโครตงี่เง่าเลย⁉️     เรื่อง “11 คืนหลอน นอนโรงพยาบาล” โดยคุณโอ๋ สาย 1        “เรื่องนี้ย้อนกลับไปประมาณ 11 ปีก่อน” คุณโอ๋และสามีพาลูกสาวที่ป่วยเข้าโรงพยาบาลเป็นประจำ จนวันหนึ่งคุณหมอให้ลูกสาวนอนพักรักษาตัวเพื่อเฝ้าดูอาการ และได้ย้ายไปพักที่ห้อง VIP บนตึกเด็ก ชั้น 14 ตั้งแต่วันแรกที่เข้าพัก “คุณโอ๋ก็เจอชายแปลกหน้าคนหนึ่ง”ยืนอยู่ตรงหัวมุมสุดทางเดิน ”ทำท่าทางเหมือนกำลังโกรธ“ แต่เมื่อเธอหันไปบอกสามี “แต่สามีกลับไม่มีใครเห็นชายคนนั้นเลย” สามีของคุณ”โอ๋เองก็รู้ดีว่าเธอมีสัมผัสเกี่ยวกับเรื่องวิญญาณ“ จึงพากันเข้าไปพักในห้อง……         ”คืนแรกผ่านไป“อย่างไม่มีอะไรเกิดขึ้น แต่พอเข้าสู่คืนที่สอง เหตุการณ์แปลก ๆ ก็เริ่มเกิดขึ้น ทั้งโทรทัศน์ที่เปิดขึ้นมาเอง และความฝันประหลาดที่มีชายคนหนึ่งคอยเดินวนเวียนอยู่ใกล้ ๆ ก่อนจะชี้หน้าคุณโอ๋และพูดว่า “ไม่ชอบคุณโอ๋”หลังจากนั้นตลอดระยะเวลา 11 คืน คุณโอ๋ต้องพบเจอกับเหตุการณ์หลอนมากมายจากผู้ชายปริศนาคนนี้‼️ จนเริ่มหวาดกลัวและสภาพจิตใจย่ำแย่ลงอย่างหนัก……เหตุการณ์ทั้งหมดกลายเป็นประสบการณ์สุดหลอนที่คุณโอ๋ยังคงจำได้จนถึงทุกวันนี้…     **แต่ฟังจบแล้วผมก็ยังสงสัยอยู่ดีว่า… ผีตัวนี้จะโกรธอะไรคุณโอ๋ขนาดนั้นวะโกรธแทนคุณโอ๋เลยคับ**‼️         📌👉🏻”แต่เรื่องราวจะเป็นอย่างไรต่อ”⁉️หากใครอยากฟังฉบับเต็ม สามารถรับฟังได้ในคลิปของ The Ghost Radio เดี๋ยวผมจะแปะลิงก์ไว้ให้พี่ ๆ เพื่อน ๆ เข้าไปรับชมและรับฟังกันนะครับ 🙏❤️         📌ลิงก์เรื่องเต็ม “” คลิกดูข้อความด้านล่างได้นะคับ👇👇     “รอทางรายการปล่อยคลิปเต็ม” แล้วผมจะนำลิงก์มาแปะไว้ให้ครับ 🙏 #ออโต้TheGhost #TheGhostRadio #เดอะโกสเรดิโอ #เรื่องเล่าผี #เรื่องหลอน   @The Ghost Radio              @แซ่บอีหลี เชียงละเบ๋อ  @สกลนคร ซิตี้          👉 หากชอบรีวิวเรื่องหลอนแบบนี้ ฝากกดไลก์ กดแชร์ และติดตามเพจ ออโต้ TheGhost เพื่อไม่พลาดรีวิวเรื่องหลอน ๆ เรื่องใหม่ด้วยนะครับ ❤️

d: When you enter a forest in the Philippines, you’re supposed to say the phrase *tabi tabi po.* It means “excuse me” or “may I please pass?” You say this because you don’t want to accidentally step on a duwende, engkanto, or any one of the many mystical beings in the forest. Filipinos are a superstitious bunch, there’s no denying that. And it might be easy to dismiss this one as an episode of magical thinking or simple folklore, but I think there’s something important about it. The forest truly is full of vibrant, living beings in every direction. And whether you’re inclined to think of duwendes or mycelium, it’s important to enter that space with respect. A reverential fear. An understanding that your presence has an impact, but an intent to do as little harm as possible.
zh: 当你进入菲律宾的森林时，你应该说“tabi tabi po”。意思是“借过”或“请让我过去”。你这么说是因为不想不小心踩到小矮人、精灵或其他森林里的神秘生物。菲律宾人很迷信，不可否认。可能很容易将此归结为魔法思维或民间传说，但我认为这其中有重要之处。森林确实充满了生机勃勃的生灵。无论你倾向于想到小矮人还是菌丝体，重要的是要带着敬畏进入那个空间。一种恭敬的恐惧。一种理解，即你的存在会产生影响，但要意图尽可能少地造成伤害。

d: "ปิดตำนานครูตลก!" ย้อนรอยชีวิต ล้อต๊อก ศิลปินแห่งชาติผู้มอบความสุขให้คนไทยจนลมหายใจสุดท้าย! "จากพลปืนกลกองทัพอากาศ สู่ตลกค้างฟ้าเจ้าของรางวัลตุ๊กตาทอง... พบเรื่องราวสุดประทับใจของ 'ป๋าต๊อก' กับชีวิตที่เปลี่ยนรูปตามภาชนะเหมือนน้ำไหล และคำสอนสุดอมตะที่สร้างศิลปินตลกระดับประเทศมาแล้วมากมาย!"  ย้อนระลึกถึงวันคล้ายวันเสียชีวิตของ นายสวง ทรัพย์สำรวย หรือ ล้อต๊อก ศิลปินแห่งชาติสาขาศิลปะการแสดงคนแรกที่เป็นนักแสดงตลก มาฟังเบื้องหลังชีวิตตั้งแต่วัยเด็กที่หนีเรียนไปเล่นดนตรีไทย จนถึงยุคสงครามโลกที่สร้างชื่อเสียงในกองทัพ และความลับที่ทำให้เขาสามารถยืนหยัดอยู่ในวงการได้นานกว่าใครในคลิปนี้ครับ มากกว่าแค่เสียงหัวเราะ! เจาะลึกฝีมือการแสดงระดับปรมาจารย์และการใช้ชีวิตที่สมถะ ณ บ้านริมน้ำเมืองแปดริ้ว ฟังบทสรุปของตำนาน 'ล้อต๊อก' ที่พิสูจน์ให้เห็นว่าอาชีพตลกคือศิลปะที่ทรงคุณค่าและมีเกียรติเหนือสิ่งอื่นใดครับ ข้อมูลอ้างอิง: นิตยสารศิลปวัฒนธรรม  เรียบเรียงเนื้อหา: TONI STYLE #ล้อต๊อก #ป๋าต๊อก #ศิลปินแห่งชาติ #ตลกไทย #ประวัติศาสตร์ไทย
h: ล้อต๊อก, ป๋าต๊อก, ศิลปินแห่งชาติ, ตลกไทย, ประวัติศาสตร์ไทย
zh: “喜剧大师的传奇落幕！”回顾国家级艺术家Lor Tok为泰国人民带来欢乐直至生命最后一刻的人生！“从空军机枪手到金娃娃奖得主的笑坛常青树……带你了解‘Tok叔’如水般随容器改变形态的精彩人生，以及他那句造就无数国家级喜剧演员的不朽教诲！”在国家级艺术家、首位获表演艺术类殊荣的喜剧演员Suang Sapsamruay（艺名Lor Tok）的逝世纪念日之际，来听听他的人生幕后故事，从逃学去学泰乐器的童年，到世界大战期间在军中成名，以及他能在演艺圈屹立不倒比任何人都久的秘密，尽在本视频。不止于欢笑！深度解析大师级表演功力，以及他在北柳府河畔简朴居所的生活，聆听‘Lor Tok’传奇的最终章。这证明了喜剧演员是一种崇高而有价值、高于一切荣誉的艺术职业。参考来源：《艺术文化》杂志 内容整理：TONI STYLE。

Liontin sendiri merupakan sebuah sinetron remaja yang menceritakan tentang kehidupan kakak beradik Indy dan Manda, yang diperankan oleh Nana dan Naysilla Mirdad. Di sinetron Liontin ini Nay berperan sebagai perempuan bernama Indy yang terpisah dengan sang kakak saat kecil.  Kemudian Nay pun bertemu lagi dengan sang kakak setelah dewasa dan tidak menyadari mereka memiliki liontin yang sama. Keduanya diketahui harus berpisah usai ibu dan ayahnya meninggal dunia untuk mencari keberadaan sang kakek.  Sebelum keduanya pergi untuk mencari sang kakek, Manda sempat memberikan sebuah kalung dengan liontin bertuliskan nama sang ibunda, Rianty, kepada sang adik. #liontin #sinetron #nanamirdad #naysillamirdad #transformasi #transformasi90

d: Alchemy, astronomy, and esoteric philosophy are vital components of surrealist artist Remedios Varo’s work. It is even said that she scratched the surface of masonite boards before painting on them to imbue her art with magic from the very beginning. 💎🔮 Varo’s painting La llamada (The Call) (1961) can be found at the National Museum of Women in the Arts in Washington D.C. and exemplifies her characteristic color palette with a central female figure, illuminated in fiery orange-gold tones, walking through shadowy, more muted surroundings. @NMWA  #WomenArtists #WomensHistoryMonth #ArtHistory #RemediosVaro
zh: 炼金术、天文学和深奥哲学是超现实主义艺术家雷梅迪奥斯·瓦罗作品的重要组成部分。甚至有人说，她在梅森奈特纤维板上作画前会刮擦其表面，以从一开始就为她的艺术注入魔力。瓦罗的画作《呼唤》（La llamada）（1961年）藏于华盛顿特区的国家女性艺术博物馆，这幅画体现了她标志性的调色板：一个中心女性形象，被炽热的橙金色调照亮，穿行于更阴暗、更柔和的背景中。@NMWA

zh: 格姆皮塔的故事：东努沙登加拉地震中出生的婴儿。小格姆皮塔早产32周，体重1.5公斤，于东努沙登加拉地震发生的第一天，周六（2026年8月15日），在东努沙登加拉纳格克奥县阿埃拉莫地区综合医院的走廊上通过紧急剖腹产出生。直到周三（2026年8月19日），格姆皮塔宝宝仍待在阿埃拉莫地区综合医院院内野战医院应急帐篷里的保温箱中。格姆皮塔宝宝是玛丽亚·佛罗里达·诺戈·克伦（39岁）的第四个孩子。卫生部长布迪·古纳迪·萨迪金在视察这所野战医院时，除了直接查看应急医疗设施外，还探望了格姆皮塔宝宝和她的母亲，以及几位正在接受治疗的地震伤者。

d: WANITA POLOS INI MASAK IKAN ARWANA MILIK SUAMI JADI BEGINI⁉️ #beritaterkini #trending #fyp #shortsvideo #shorts  Seorang istri yang disebut masih polos ini justru mengalami kejadian tak terduga saat hendak memasak ikan. Melihat akuarium yang hanya berisi satu ekor ikan, ia mengira ikan tersebut merupakan ikan biasa dan berpikir lebih baik dimasak daripada mubazir. Tanpa mengetahui jenis ikan tersebut, ikan pun kemudian diolah menjadi masakan gulai dengan bumbu kuning. Masakan tersebut bahkan disebut sudah siap disantap sebelum akhirnya diketahui bahwa ikan yang dimasak ternyata bukan ikan biasa. Belakangan, ikan tersebut disebut merupakan ikan arwana bersertifikat yang memiliki nilai jual cukup tinggi. Bahkan, harganya disebut-sebut bisa mencapai nilai yang setara dengan sebuah motor skuter matik terbaru. Momen tak terduga ini pun langsung membuat warganet ikut geleng-geleng kepala.

d: Braised Chicken Legs with Rice, Potatoes & Veggies🍗 Ingredients * 1 package chicken drumsticks (6–7 pieces) * 1-2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp salt * 1 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp garlic powder * 2 tsp onion powder * 2 tsp paprika * ½ tsp cumin * 1 jalapeño, diced * ½ red onion, diced * 1 tbsp sun-dried tomato paste * 1 tbsp @Loisa sofrito * 5–6 garlic cloves, minced * 4 cups chicken stock * 1 (8 oz) can tomato sauce * Small potatoes, halved (about 10–12 baby potatoes) * 1 zucchini, diced * Cooked white rice, for serving (let me know if you guys want my rice recipe) Instructions: 1. Clean the chicken with vinegar, then pat completely dry with paper towels. 2. Season the chicken with the salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and cumin. Toss until evenly coated. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven or deep skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Brown the chicken for 2–3 minutes per side until golden. It doesn’t need to be cooked through. Remove and set aside. 5. In the same pot, add the diced jalapeño and red onion. Cook for about 5 minutes until softened. 6. Stir in the sun-dried tomato paste and cook for 30 seconds. 7. Add the Loisa Sofrito and minced garlic. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant. 8. Pour in the chicken stock and tomato sauce, stirring to combine. Bring to a gentle boil. 9. Return the chicken to the pot. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 1 hour, or until the chicken is fall-apart tender and the sauce has reduced. 10. About 20 minutes before the chicken is done, add the halved potatoes and diced zucchini. Continue simmering until the potatoes are fork-tender and the zucchini is cooked. 11. Serve over fluffy white rice and spoon plenty of the sauce over the top. #chickenlegs #braised #onepotmeals #cookwithme
zh: 红烧鸡腿配米饭、土豆和蔬菜🍗 食材 * 1包鸡腿（6-7个） * 1-2汤匙橄榄油 * 1茶匙盐 * 1茶匙黑胡椒 * 2茶匙大蒜粉 * 2茶匙洋葱粉 * 2茶匙辣椒粉 * ½茶匙孜然 * 1个墨西哥辣椒，切丁 * ½个红洋葱，切丁 * 1汤匙油浸番茄干酱 * 1汤匙@Loisa sofrito酱 * 5-6瓣大蒜，切末 * 4杯鸡高汤 * 1罐（8盎司）番茄酱 * 小土豆，对半切（约10-12个小土豆） * 1个西葫芦，切丁 * 熟白米饭，上菜用（想要米饭食谱的话告诉我） 步骤：1. 用醋清洗鸡肉，然后用厨房纸巾彻底擦干。2. 用盐、胡椒、大蒜粉、洋葱粉、辣椒粉和孜然给鸡肉调味，翻拌均匀。3. 用中大火在大型荷兰锅或深煎锅中加热橄榄油。4. 将鸡肉每面煎2-3分钟至金黄。不需要完全煎熟。取出备用。5. 同一个锅里，加入切丁的墨西哥辣椒和红洋葱。炒约5分钟至变软。6. 加入油浸番茄干酱，翻炒30秒。7. 加入Loisa Sofrito酱和蒜末。炒1分钟至出香味。8. 倒入鸡高汤和番茄酱，搅拌混合。煮至微沸。9. 将鸡肉放回锅中。调至小火，盖上盖子，慢炖约1小时，直到鸡肉软烂脱骨

d: Ide masak daging qurban yang paling seger! 🥩 Tanpa santan, ga pake ribet, dan dagingnya udah pasti empuk 😍😘 SOP DAGING Bahan 1: • 400 Gr Daging Sapi • 1.500 ml Air • 2½ SDT Garam Bahan 2: • 2 Batang Seledri (rajang kasar) • 2 Batang Daun Bawang Prei (potong 1 cm) • ¼ Biji Pala (bila suka) • 2 Buah Kentang • 1 Buah Wortel Bahan 3: • 75 Gr Buncis • 75 Gr Kol • 2 SDT Desaku bawang putih bubuk • 1 Sachet Ladaku merica bubuk • 2 SDM Bawang Goreng Cara Memasak: 1. Masukkan daging, air dan garam ke dalam panci. Rebus dengan api sedang sampai mendidih, kemudian buang busanya. 2. Lanjutkan merebus dengan panci tertutup sampai 3/4 matang (+/- 60 menit). 3. Masukkan Daun Bawang, Seledri, Pala (bila suka), Kentang dan Wortel masak sampai daging empuk (+/- 30 menit). 4. Masukkan buncis, kol, Desaku Bawang Putih Bubuk dan Ladaku Merica Bubuk. zh: 辣味牛肉松🥩🍛 17号比赛结束后总是特别饿。关键就是吃印尼菜，要辣、鲜、香、浓😍🥰 🔽食谱🔽 焖煮用料：牛肩肉1公斤，红葱头10个（剁碎），大蒜10瓣（剁碎），罗望子酱1汤匙，香叶3片，香茅4根，南姜1拇指大块，青柠叶8片，芫荽粉1汤匙，盐半汤匙，味精1汤匙，牛肉高汤粉1汤匙，嫩椰子水1.1升 研磨香料：大红辣椒12个，红卷辣椒20个，红小米椒5个，红葱头18个，大蒜4瓣 炒制香料：Sunco食用油，研磨香料，青柠叶8片，牛肉高汤粉1茶匙，味精1茶匙，盐半茶匙，罗望子汁1汤匙 17号庆典你们在做什么？我嘛，还是做印尼菜，当然用的油是SunCo。挂得住的是美味，不是油。何况SunCo是100%印尼原产食用油🥰😍

d: If you’re looking for Indonesian food in Melbourne, add this to your list! 👀 Kenangan is an Indonesian family style restaurant on Little Bourke Street in Melbourne CBD. It has recently relocated from its original QVM location, bringing the same flavours, team - and heart. 🇮🇩 The name Kenangan means “memories” in Indonesian. It started during COVID as a family passion project selling vacuum sealed, ready to heat meals before growing into a physical restaurant!  The new space continues that idea of bringing the feeling of Indonesian home cooking to the table, with the menu centred around “Makan Tengah”, family style dining.  It was designed with an Indonesian architect, with details inspired by traditional Indonesian homes including terracotta tiles, bamboo style ceilings and ceramic flooring. ⭐️ Bakwan Sayur (Fried Vegetable Fritters) - huge! The peanut sauce is perfect and tastes really authentic. ⭐️ Iga Semur (Braised Angus Prime Beef Ribs) - so flavourful and fall apart tender. Definitely one of my favourites. ✔️ Udang Goreng Telur Serabut (Fried Prawn with Egg Floss) - the batter is perfectly crispy. I did think it needed a sauce alongside it though, otherwise a whole bowl felt quite dry to eat. You can order sauces separately, so I’d definitely add one. ⭐️ Ayam Bakar Plecing (Grilled Chicken Glazed with Sambal Plecing) - the leg piece was much more moist than the breast, as expected. The flavour is fantastic and definitely sits around the mid to high range of spice. ✔️ Mie Goreng Chicken Kenangen (Fried Noodles) ✔️ Urap Timum (Cucumber Salad with Spiced Coconut) - I’d never had this before and really loved the coconut. Such a nice fresh element alongside the richer dishes. ✔️ Roti Bakar (Sweet Toasted Bread) - buttery crisp edges with chocolate sprinkles, hazelnut and cheddar cheese. I loved the combination of sweet and savoury here. ✔️ Es Kalapa (Iced Coconut) ➖ Es Alpukat (Avocado Smoothie) I’d definitely recommend ordering a few dishes to share, everything was full of flavour and texture. It was completely packed mid week, with plenty of regulars who were raving about the food.  (Paid Honest Review)

KUE TETE / APE (aka Boobie Cake) 😜✨ Welcome to my “Learning How to Cook Indonesian Food” series!  Where I challenge myself to learn a new Indonesian Recipe every week. This week is all about KUE APE - one of Indonesia’s most nostalgic sweet streetfood treats. 🇮🇩🙌🏼 We often call it Kue Tete (Titty Cake) cause…. I mean… is it not obvious?? 🤣 It’s thin and crispy on the edges, with a centre that’s thicker, soft, fluffy, and slightly chewy. It tastes like pandan and coconut and it’s absolutely DELISH! 💕 INGREDIENTS - 170g All Purpose Flour (Medium Protein) 45gr Rice Flour 35gr Tapioca Flour 1/4tsp Salt 145gr Sugar 1tsp Baking Powder 1/4tsp Baking Soda 1tsp Panda Paste or Extract 150gr Instant Coconut Cream 350gr Water HOW TO COOK - 1. Add All Purpose Flour, Rice Flour, Tapioca Flour, Salt, Sugar, Baking Powder and Baking Soda in a bowl. Give it a whisk.  2. Then add the Pandan Extract, Instant Coconut Cream, and Water to the bowl. Whisk thoroughly, and rest the batter for 30min.  3. Heat up a small non-stick wok. Once hot, add a ladle of batter, and turn the wok all around (so the batter gets to the sides of the wok and makes a circle shape). Close the wok with a lid, and cook the kue ape over low-medium heat until the sides turn light brown. 4. Take the Kue Ape off the wok, let it cool slightly and eat! Recook from @Luvita Ho ✨ #indonesianfood #kueape #easyrecipe #themainingredient #MakanDenganMakna

Resep Ayam Goreng Padang (untuk 8 porsi) Bahan marinasi: 2 ekor ayam pejantan utuh 1 buah jeruk nipis bumbu halus Bahan bumbu halus: 6 siung bawang putih 2 sdt ketumbar 4 cm jahe, iris 4 cm kunyit, iris 8 cm lengkuas, iris 5 lembar daun jeruk, buang batang 2 sdt garam 2 sdt kaldu ayam bubuk ¼ sdt merica 1 sdt penyedap 75 gr kelapa parut 4 sdm tepung beras 2 butir telur Bahan sambal cabe ijo: 100 ml minyak 15 siung bawang merah 160 gr cabai hijau, potong 2 buah tomat hijau, iris 5 lembar daun jeruk 1 sdt garam 1 sdt penyedap Pelengkap: nasi putih timun, kupas jeruk nipis Cara membuat: 1. Untuk bumbu halus, siapkan blender dan masukkan bawang putih, ketumbar, jahe, kunyit, lengkuas, daun jeruk, garam, kaldu ayam bubuk, merica, penyedap, kelapa parut, tepung beras dan telur, lalu haluskan 2. Potong ayam menjadi empat bagian dan buang kulitnya. Marinasi ayam dengan perasan jeruk nipis dan bumbu halus, aduk merata. Diamkan minimal 1 jam di suhu ruang atau semalaman di kulkas 3. Goreng ayam yang sudah dimarinasi di minyak panas dengan api sedang hingga matang kecokelatan, angkat dan tiriskan 4. Untuk tambahan serundeng, goreng sisa bumbu marinasi hingga kuning keemasan lalu angkat dan tiriskan 5. Untuk sambal cabe ijo, panaskan minyak sisa menggoreng ayam, lalu masukkan bawang merah dan cabai hijau yang sudah dipotong, tumis hingga layu. Siapkan food chopper dan masukkan tumisan bawang merah dan cabai hijau, lalu haluskan sesaat 6. Tumis tomat hijau dengan minyak sisa tumisan bawang dan cabai. Tambahkan daun jeruk dan bahan sambal yang sudah dihaluskan, tumis sesaat. Tambahkan garam dan penyedap, aduk rata 7. Ayam Goreng Padang siap disajikan
zh: 巴东炸鸡配方（8人份）腌制材料：2只整只公鸡、1个青柠、香料酱。香料酱材料：6瓣大蒜、2茶匙香菜、4厘米生姜切片、4厘米姜黄切片、8厘米高良姜切片、5片去茎青柠叶、2茶匙盐、2茶匙鸡精粉、¼茶匙胡椒粉、1茶匙调味料、75克椰丝、4汤匙米粉、2个鸡蛋。青辣椒酱材料：100毫升油、15瓣红葱头、160克青辣椒切段、2个青番茄切片、5片青柠叶、1茶匙盐、1茶匙调味料。配菜：白米饭、去皮黄瓜、青柠。做法：1. 制作香料酱：将大蒜、香菜、姜、姜黄、高良姜、青柠叶、盐、鸡精粉、胡椒粉、调味料、椰丝、米粉和鸡蛋放入搅拌机打碎。2. 鸡肉切四大块并去皮。用青柠汁和香料酱腌制鸡肉，拌匀。室温静置至少1小时或冰箱冷藏过夜。3. 将腌好的鸡肉用中火油炸至熟透呈棕褐色，捞出沥油。4. 制作椰蓉：将剩余腌料炸至金黄，捞出沥油。5. 制作青辣椒酱：加热炸鸡余油，放入红葱头和青辣椒翻炒至软。用食物料理机将其短暂打碎。6. 用余油炒青番茄，加入青柠叶和打碎的辣椒酱，稍加翻炒。加入盐和调味料，拌匀。7. 巴东炸鸡即可上桌。

d: Nasi Goreng Indonesia - Indonesian Fried Rice #friedrice #easyrecipes #recipe  Ingredients 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 egg 3 cups cooked rice 4 slices fish cake, thinly sliced 4 large prawns, peeled and deveined A handful of fresh squid, cleaned and sliced 1 tbsp light soy sauce 2 tbsp kecap manis (sweet soy sauce) 1 tsp dark caramel sauce 1 tbsp sambal (adjust to taste) Large pinch of YumYum or MSG 1 bird’s eye chili, finely sliced 1 spring onion, thinly sliced 2 tbsp fried garlic Sliced cucumber and tomato, to serve Fried egg, to serve INSTRUCTIONS 1. Heat a wok over high heat and add a splash of oil. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry until fragrant. 2. Crack in the egg and scramble it quickly, breaking it into small pieces as it cooks. 3. Add the cooked rice to the wok and toss thoroughly, breaking up any clumps and ensuring it’s well-coated in the egg and garlic mixture. 4. Add the fish cake, prawns, and squid. Toss everything together and stir-fry until the seafood is cooked through. 5. Mix in the light soy sauce, kecap manis, dark caramel sauce, and sambal. Stir well to evenly coat the rice and proteins with the sauce. 6. Toss in the bird’s eye chili and sliced spring onion. Stir-fry briefly to combine. 7. Sprinkle the fried garlic over the rice and give it one final toss. 8. Serve hot, garnished with sliced cucumber and tomato, and top with a fried egg.
zh: 印尼炒饭 食材：3瓣蒜切末、1个鸡蛋、3杯熟米饭、4片鱼饼切薄片、4只大虾去壳去虾线、一把鲜鱿鱼处理干净切片、1汤匙生抽、2汤匙甜酱油、1茶匙黑焦糖酱、1汤匙参巴酱（可根据口味调整）、一大撮味精、1根鸟眼辣椒切碎、1根葱切薄片、2汤匙炸蒜。配菜：黄瓜片、番茄片、煎蛋。做法：1. 大火烧热炒锅，加少许油。放入蒜末爆香。2. 打入鸡蛋，快速炒散成小块。3. 加入米饭，彻底翻炒，打散结块，确保米饭均匀裹上蛋和蒜。4. 加入鱼饼、虾仁和鱿鱼，翻炒至海鲜熟透。5. 加入生抽、甜酱油、黑焦糖酱和参巴酱，翻炒均匀，使酱汁包裹米饭和食材。6. 加入鸟眼辣椒和葱花，快速翻炒均匀。7. 撒上炸蒜，最后翻炒一次。8. 趁热上桌，用黄瓜片、番茄片装饰，并放上一个煎蛋。

zh: 黑椒牛肉✅✅ 意思是妈妈我又富了。做这道菜时家里肯定香气四溢，然后又因为胡椒味流鼻涕，但我超爱，因为黑胡椒和彩椒的独特香味，配饭吃太棒了，嘻嘻。来做吧！牛肉腌制料：300克牛肉（切片）、1汤匙玉米淀粉、1汤匙酱油、1汤匙甜酱油、1茶匙小苏打、1茶匙胡椒粉。其他材料：1个红彩椒（切块）、1个青彩椒（切块）、3瓣大蒜（切碎）、半个洋葱（切块）、1茶匙黑胡椒粉、1汤匙伍斯特酱、1汤匙酱油、1汤匙蚝油、1汤匙甜酱油、1汤匙芝麻油、1根葱（切段）、2汤匙玉米淀粉水。做法：1. 用腌制料腌牛肉15分钟。2. 炒熟腌好的牛肉，盛出。3. 炒香大蒜和洋葱至软，加入炒好的牛肉，拌匀。4. 加入黑胡椒粉、伍斯特酱、酱油、蚝油、甜酱油和芝麻油，拌匀。5. 加入红青彩椒、葱段和玉米淀粉水，翻炒至浓稠。6. 即可上桌。祝你尝试成功，即使你很懒。

d: Kasus dugaan keracunan makanan bergizi gratis (MBG) melanda SMPN 6 Boyolali pada Jumat (21/8/2026), berdampak pada 96 siswa dan empat tenaga kependidikan (tiga guru dan satu petugas TU). Gejala muncul setelah korban mengonsumsi menu MBG yang dibagikan pada Kamis (20/8/2026) pukul 09.00 WIB. Pihak Satuan Pelayanan Pemenuhan Gizi (SPPG) Siswodipuran 2 bersama Puskesmas Boyolali I dan Dinas Kesehatan (Dinkes) Boyolali langsung menangani para korban serta melakukan penyelidikan epidemiologis di lokasi. Korban mulai merasakan mulas, mual, perut melilit, diare, hingga pusing sekitar pukul 16.00 WIB pasca-konsumsi. Dari 96 siswa yang melaporkan gejala, 17 anak menjalani pemeriksaan fisik intensif serta pengobatan dari tim Puskesmas Boyolali I. Sekolah juga mencatat 26 siswa lain yang absen sakit pada hari Jumat untuk diverifikasi gejalanya. Paket MBG yang disajikan meliputi nasi putih, tahu pong, buah kelengkeng, serta sup manten berisikan makaroni, wortel, irisan ayam, dan jamur. Wakil Kepala SMPN 6 Boyolali, Marsih Sri Hartini, menyebutkan aroma bahan ayam dan jamur pada sup terindikasi agak berbau. Kepala Dinkes Boyolali, FX Kristandiyoko, mengonfirmasi bahwa sampel makanan (khususnya komponen jamur dan sup) telah dikirim ke Labkesmas Semarang untuk menguji potensi cemaran seperti E. coli. Evaluasi juga dilakukan pada proses pencucian bahan, higienitas penyaji, dan ketersediaan air bersih. Seluruh siswa di kelas VIII E dilaporkan aman dari gejala karena tidak mengonsumsi menu tersebut. Selain kasus di SMPN 6, Dinkes Boyolali turut memantau kondisi lima siswa SMPN 2 Boyolali yang dilaporkan sakit guna mendalami keterkaitannya. Reporter: Nimatul Faizah Editor: MD Praditia
zh: 疑似免费营养餐中毒事件袭击了博约拉利县第六公立初中，发生在周五（2026年8月21日），波及96名学生和4名教职员工（3名教师和1名行政人员）。症状是在受害者食用了周四（2026年8月20日）09:00 WIB分发的免费营养餐后出现的。Siswodipuran 2号营养服务单位与博约拉利第一社区卫生中心及博约拉利县卫生局立即处理了受害者，并在现场进行了流行病学调查。受害者于食用后约16:00 WIB开始感到难受、恶心、腹部绞痛、腹泻，直至头晕。在96名报告症状的学生中，17名儿童接受了来自博约拉利第一社区卫生中心团队的强化体检和治疗。学校还记录了另外26名在周五因病缺勤的学生，以核实其症状。提供的免费营养餐包括白米饭、豆腐泡、龙眼果，以及包含通心粉、胡萝卜、鸡肉丝和蘑菇的Manten汤。博约拉利县第六公立初中副校长Marsih Sri Hartini表示，汤里的鸡肉和蘑菇食材闻起来有点异味。博约拉利县卫生局长FX Kristandiyoko证实，食物样本（特别是蘑菇和汤的成分）已被送往三宝垄卫生实验室中心，以检测潜在的大肠杆菌等污染。同时也在评估食材清洗过程、配餐员卫生状况和清洁水源的可及性。VIII E班所有学生报告因未食用该菜单而安全无虞。除了第六公立初中的病例，博约拉利县卫生局也在监测据报生病的博约拉利县第二公立初中五名学生的情况，以深入了解其关联性。记者：Nimatul Faizah 编辑：MD Praditia

d: Mac n cheese with garlic butter steak bites 🤤 RECIPE⬇️ Mac n cheese: * 12 oz pasta * Chicken bouillon (for boiling pasta) * 10 oz sharp white cheddar * 8 oz Colby Jack * 5-6 oz Mozzarella  * 2 oz Parmesan * 3 tbs butter * 3 tbs flour * 1 cup heavy cream (1.5 if you prefer saucier) * 1 12-oz can evaporated milk * 1 tsp Dijon mustard * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp paprika * Salt and pepper to taste Garlic butter steak bites: * 1 lb steak, cut into bite size cubes  * 1 tsp each: garlic powder, smoked paprika, Worcestershire * 1/2 tsp Montreal steak seasoning * 1/2 tsp dried thyme * Drizzle of oil  * Salt and pepper to taste * 1/2 stick butter * 1/4 small shallot, minced * 4-5 garlic cloves, minced * Optional: chopped parsley for garnish 1. In a bowl, mix the steak with some oil and all the seasonings. Let that marinate while you prep the mac. 2. Shred cheeses and mix together. Set aside. 3. Boil pasta in water that has been generously seasoned with chicken bouillon or salt until al dente, 1-2 min below box instructions. 4. Melt butter and bloom the spices - garlic powder, paprika - for 1 min. Then add the flour and cook for a 1-2 mins. 5. While whisking, slowly add in the heavy cream and evaporated milk. Whisk until smooth.  6. Once the mixture warms up again (but NOT simmering) turn off the heat and stir in half of your cheese mixture in batches until combined. 7. Layer in a baking dish, starting with half the mac mixture, half of the leftover cheese, the rest of the mac, and finally the rest of the cheese. Sprinkle some paprika on top for color. 8. Bake at 375F for 25-30 min until golden. Broil on low for a few min for more crust if desired. 9. While the mac is baking, add oil to a pan and sear the steak until desired doneness and it develops a nice crust. 10. 1 min before the steak is done, add 1/2 stick butter, garlic, and shallots and cook for the remaining time. 11. When mac is done baking, rest 10 min before serving and top with the steak bites. #macandcheese #steakbites #garlicbutter #creamypasta

d: EASY MEALS FOR 2, EP. 24 🍯 Honey Garlic Chicken Ingredients Chicken * 375g-400g boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces * 1 tsp salt * 1 tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp black pepper * ¼ cup cornstarch Sauce * 60g honey (about 3 tbsp) * 2 tbsp soy sauce * 1 tbsp oyster sauce * 1 tbsp rice vinegar * 19g garlic, minced (4–5 large cloves) * 12g green onion whites, finely sliced Cornstarch Slurry * 1 tsp cornstarch * 2 tsp water Garnish * Sesame seeds * Sliced green onion greens Directions 1. Toss the chicken with the salt, garlic powder, pepper, and cornstarch until evenly coated. 2. Heat enough neutral oil to lightly coat the bottom of a pan. Shallow fry the chicken over medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. 3. Reduce to medium heat. If needed, add a little more oil, then sauté the garlic and green onion whites for 30–60 seconds until fragrant. 4. Pour in the honey, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and rice vinegar. Simmer for 1–2 minutes. 5. Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook until the sauce thickens. 6. Return the chicken to the pan and toss until every piece is well coated. 7. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions greens Serve with steamed rice and enjoy! 🍚 #honeygarlicchicken #chickenrecipe #easyrecipe #cooking #creatorsearchinsights

d: #แจกสูตรหมกเห็ดเข็มทอง ใส่สมุนไพรเน้นๆ เพิ่มความนุ่มละมุนด้วยไข่ไก่ และความอร่อยจากหมูสับ บอกเลยว่าแซ่บมาก!! **อัตราส่วน** เห็ดเข็มทอง 500 กรัม ตะไคร้ซอย 3 ต้น กระเทียมจีน 5 กลีบ หอมแดง 6 หัว พริกแดงจินดา 20 เม็ด พริกแกงเผ็ด 1 ชต. หมูสับ 150 กรัม ไข่ไก่ 3 ฟอง น้ำปลา 1 ชต. น้ำตาลทราย 1 ชช. น้ำปลาร้า 2 ชต. (ใช้น้ำปลาร้าปรุงสำเร็จ) ผงชูรส 1 ชช.  ใบมะกรูดซอย 1-2 ชต. ใบแมงลัก 1 มัด ใบตอง,ไม้กลัด  วิธีทำ 1. นำเห็ดเข็มทองมาตัดโคนทิ้ง แล้วชั่งให้ได้ 500 กรัม นำไปล้างผ่านน้ำแบบเร็วๆ พักให้สะเด็ดน้ำ 2. โขลกเครื่องแกงได้แก่ ตะไคร้ซอย กระเทียมจีน หอมแดง และพริกแดงจินดา โขลกแค่พอหยาบๆ  3. นำเครื่องแกงที่โขลกแล้ว ใส่ลงไปในในชามผสม ตามด้วยพริกแกงเผ็ด ไข่ไก่ หมูสับ น้ำปลา น้ำตาลทราย น้ำปลาร้า และผงชูรส นวดคลุกเคล้าให้เข้ากันดี แล้วใส่เห็ดเข็มทองลงไป นวดจนทุกอย่างเข้ากันดี แล้วค่อยใส่ใบแมงลัก และใบมะกรูดซอย คลุกเคล้าให้เข้ากันดี 4. นำใบตองสองใบประกบกัน ตักส่วนผสมที่ได้ลงไปประมาณ 2 ชต.พูนๆ แล้วจัดการห่อเหมือนขนมใส่ไส้ นำไปนึ่งด้วยไฟกลางค่อนแรง 15-20 นาที 5. สูตรนี้ทำได้ประมาณ 10 ห่อ  **คำแนะนำ** เมื่อผสมทุกอย่างเข้ากันดีแล้ว ก่อนที่จะห่อใบตองแล้วนำไปนึ่ง เราสามารถชิมรสได้ โดยตักส่วนผสมสักเล็กน้อยใส่ถ้วยทนความร้อน นำเข้าไมโครเวฟให้สุกแล้วชิมรส ถ้าจืดไปก็สามารถเพิ่มน้ำปลา หรือน้ำปลาร้าได้  #หม#หมกเห็ดเข็มทองม#แม่ซีน้องมดดี้channel

zh: 放入大量草本，加鸡蛋增添软嫩和猪肉碎的美味，非常爽辣。比例：金针菇500克、香茅碎3根、中国蒜5瓣、红葱头6颗、红辣椒20颗、辣酱1汤匙、猪肉碎150克、鸡蛋3个、鱼露1汤匙、砂糖1茶匙、腌鱼汁2汤匙、味精1茶匙、箭叶橙叶丝1-2汤匙、圣罗勒叶1把、芭蕉叶、竹签。做法：1. 切掉金针菇根部，称足500克，快速冲洗后沥干。2. 将香茅、中国蒜、红葱头和红辣椒捣成粗碎。3. 将捣好的香料放入碗中，加入辣酱、鸡蛋、猪肉碎、鱼露、砂糖、腌鱼汁和味精，揉匀后加入金针菇，拌匀，最后放入圣罗勒叶和箭叶橙叶丝拌匀。4. 将两片芭蕉叶叠起，舀入约2汤匙多满的馅料，包成甜品状，中大火蒸15-20分钟。5. 此配方可做约10包。建议：混合好后，可取少许放入耐热碗用微波炉弄熟试味，淡了可加鱼露或腌鱼汁。

d: One of Thailand’s most famous dishes and I Couldn’t stop eating this when I was over there so I had to recreate it at home to  best ofmy abilities. Spicy, fragrant and absolutely delicious. 📝INGREDIENTS  -jasmine rice  -pork/beef/ chicken mince and for one serving I used around 250-300g  -Thai holy basil *I got mine from a international food shop. Shoutout @mattas1984 ( if you can’t source it Thai basil is a good alternative but remember it’s not the same , I’ve also seen people use 80% Italian basil and 20% mint with a pinch of clove) For the sauce I liked mine a bit darker so you don’t have to use these exact measurements, once you use the fish, oyster and soy sauce you’re on the right track. I’ve even some places use chicken stock and they have the meat more soft than crispy , it’s really down to you. -2tsp fish sauce  -optionally a tsp of light soy  -1tsp dark soy -2tsp of oyster sauce  -6 garlic  -7-9 Thai red chillies if you want it spicy , 3-4 if you want it mild. If you can’t get Thai red chillies , normal red chillies can be used. -cooking oil  -shallots  -fried egg  -green beans  As always in my videos I just get ingredients that aren’t pricey and I always get them from Aldi/Lidil/Asda , Asian markets near me or Amazon. Follow for more naasty recipes if you enjoy or watch the longer more in depth versions of my videos on my YouTube channel 👍✅ #padkrapao #thaïfood #thaicooking #holybasil #staynaasty

d: Cheesy garlic chicken with roast potatoes 🥦🧀  You can find the full written recipe on my Recipe Portal 🙌 Macros per serve 💪  59g protein 32g fat 37g carbs 670 calories per serve 🤝 Ingredients for 4 servings: For the chicken 🍗  800g Chicken Breast 40g Salted Butter 1.5 Tbsp Italian Mixed Herbs 3 Cloves of Garlic 1.5 Tbsp Olive Oil 200g Mozzarella Save a little marinade for the last 5 mins under the mozzarella 🧄  For the potatoes 🥔  700g Potatoes 1 Tbsp Italian Mixed Herbs 1.5 Tsp Paprika Salt & Pepper 1 Tbsp Olive Oil 50g Parmesan Serve with 🥦  Couple bunches of Broccolini Cooking instructions 👨‍🍳  Air fryer: Potatoes at 200°C for 20–25 mins & add chicken after 8–10 mins at 190/200°C, then parmesan on the potatoes + garlic butter & mozzarella on the chicken for the final 5 mins 👌  Oven: Potatoes at 220°C (200°C fan) for 30/35 mins and add chicken after 15 mins, then parmesan on the potatoes + garlic butter & mozzarella on the chicken for the final 5 mins 🙏  #highprotein #easyrecipes #dinnerideas #wholefoods #familycooking

CHICKEN KEBAB #food #recipe #chicken #kebab GROUND CHICKEN 50 g red bell pepper, finely diced 50 g green bell pepper, finely diced 15 g fresh parsley, finely chopped 100 g yellow onion (1 onion), finely chopped 4 garlic cloves, finely chopped 7 g salt (1⅙ tsp) 5 g ground cumin (1⅔ tsp) 5 g paprika (1⅔ tsp) 1 g chili flakes 3 g cayenne pepper (1 tsp) 2 g black pepper (⅔ tsp) lemon juice (½ lemon) 45 ml olive oil 750 g ground chicken WRAP wraps vegetables of your choice sauce of your choice Ready all the ingredients. Add the red bell pepper, green bell pepper, fresh parsley, yellow onion, and garlic to a food processor. Blend until you have a vegetable mixture. Transfer the vegetable mixture to a large, deep bowl. Add the salt, ground cumin, paprika, chili flakes, cayenne pepper, black pepper, lemon juice, olive oil, and ground chicken. Knead until combined. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread the chicken mixture evenly over the baking sheet and press it down firmly. Then cut the mixture into straight strips. Use a spoon to press half-moon shapes next to each other. Place the kebab in a preheated oven at 225°C (440°F). Bake for 20–25 minutes. Then switch the oven to the grill setting and grill for 5 minutes, or until the top is nicely golden brown and slightly crispy. Take a wrap and spread with your desired sauce. Fill the wrap with vegetables and pieces of kebab. Fold the wrap until closed. Grill the filled wrap until the wrap is nicely crispy and golden brown.

d: You should try this(kaleji, liver) recipe once, and then thank me later! 😋🔥 Ingredients: * 1 beef liver, cut into cubes * 2 onions, sliced * 2–3 tomatoes, chopped * 1 tbsp Kashmiri chilli powder * 1 tbsp coriander powder * 1 tbsp cumin powder * ½ tbsp black pepper powder * 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste * 1 tbsp salt * ½ cup oil * Green chillies, to taste * Sliced onion, for finishing Method: 1. Fry 2 sliced onions until golden and crispy. Drain on a paper towel and crush them. 2. Mix the beef liver with all the spices, ginger-garlic paste and crushed fried onions. Marinate for 2–3 hours. 3. Heat ½ cup oil in a pan and sauté the marinated liver. 4. Add chopped tomatoes, cover and cook on very low heat for 10–15 minutes. 5. Remove the lid, add salt and mix well. 6. Add green chillies and sliced onions. Mix and cook briefly. 7. Serve hot with naan or paratha. #kaleji #liver #cookingtales11 #fyp #foryou

zh: 肉酱还是奶油西葫芦？你选吧。你最爱的意面酱，随时在冷冻室等你。欢迎来到冷冻块备餐法：大量熬煮你喜欢的酱汁，分装冷冻，想吃意面时，只需拿出一块，选好面条加热即可。大约15分钟就能开饭。不用连着几天吃一样的东西，也不用发愁做什么。打开冷冻室，挑选你当下最想吃的口味！这方法彻底改变了我们的备餐方式，老实说，冷冻室里塞满自制意面酱，是最幸福的事之一。我们的全套系统及20款冷冻意面酱食谱都在《意面备餐食谱》里！链接见主页！备餐愉快！

d: 🇵🇭 Kare Kare | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 10 Kare-kare is a rich Filipino stew made with oxtail, tripe, and vegetables, all simmered in a thick peanut sauce. It’s usually served with bagoong (fermented shrimp paste) on the side to balance the flavors and an extra level of umami and saltiness 😋 INGREDIENTS: Boiling liquid: - 1-2 red onions, chopped - 2 bulbs of garlic, chopped - 1 tbsp of salt - 1 tbsp peppercorns - 5-6 bay leaves - 1 kg of oxtail - 650g of ox tripe - Beef stock as needed Kare Kare: - 10g of annatto powder - 2 tablespoons oil - 15-20 cloves garlic, minced - 2 tbsp annatto powder - 1 white onion, diced - 1 banana heart, chopped, washed and rinsed w/ salt - Beef stock as needed - green beans, chopped - eggplants, quartered - pechay/bok choy - 1 ½ cup peanut butter - Patis to taste - ½ teaspoon salt - 1 tbsp of sugar (optional to taste) Toasted rice slurry: - 1:5 tbsp of water to toasted rice, blended Served with:  - Bagoong  - Crushed peanuts INSTRUCTIONS:  - Start by seasoning your meat with salt and pepper and sear. Add all ingredients under “boiling liquid” and fill the pot as needed with beef stock. Simmer until tender, remove meat and set aside the broth for later.  - Saute onions, garlic, and banana hearts in oil mixed with annatto powder. Add your meat back and cover with the broth from the boiling liquid and simmer for 15-20 minutes. - To thicken the mixture, add toasted rice to a food processor or blender. Take some of the rice and mix with water to form our slurry.  - Add both rice slurry and peanut butter stir and reduce to thicken. Season with patis/salt/pepper and add your vegetables.  - Serve alongside bagoong top and enjoy!  #CookingASMR #ASMR #FilipinoFood #PinoyFood
zh: 菲律宾咖喱炖菜 | 菲律宾美食圣经第10集。用牛尾、牛肚和蔬菜在浓稠花生酱中炖煮而成，通常配虾酱以平衡风味、增添鲜味和咸度。配料：炖煮用料-红洋葱、蒜、盐、胡椒粒、月桂叶、牛尾、牛肚、牛高汤；咖喱炖菜用-红木粉、油、蒜、白洋葱、香蕉花、高汤、四季豆、茄子、小白菜、花生酱、鱼露等。做法：腌制肉类并煎制，加入炖煮料和高汤煮至软烂；用红木粉油炒香洋葱、蒜和香蕉花，加入肉和高汤炖煮；混合炒米粉调浆，与花生酱一同加入搅拌收浓，调味并加入蔬菜，配虾酱享用。

d: Filipino Desserts for my Filipino Girlfriend Episode 1: Mango Sago Let me know what I should make next! Ingredients - 5  ChampagneMangoes (3 topping, 2 puree) - 2 cups of coconut milk - 1 cup of sweetened condensed milk - 1 cup of coconut jelly - 1 cup of tapioca pearls Instructions: 1. Boil tapioca pearls while stirring constantly for 5 minutes 2. Turn off the heat and cover for 25-30 minutes until the pearls are translucent 3. Combine mangoes, coconut milk, and condensed milk, then blend until smooth 6. d: 🇵🇭 Pork Adobo | Filipino Food Bible – Episode 1 My take on one of the most iconic Filipino dishes - Pork Adobo! This series will feature all filipino dishes in all their variations. consider this your guide to filipino cuisine. comment what you wanna see next! INGREDIENTS: Pork Adobo - 1.2 kg pork belly (or cut of choice) - 15–20 cloves garlic, minced (adjust to taste—more is always welcome) - 1 onion, chopped - 500 ml pork broth - 190 ml soy sauce - 100 ml cane vinegar - 3 long green chilies - 4 bay leaves - 1 tbsp whole peppercorns - 30 g palm sugar, chopped (adjust to sweetness) - Oil, for frying Toppings - Sliced onion leeks - Crispy garlic bits - Boiled eggs INSTRUCTIONS - Fry the pork until lightly browned on all sides, then remove and set aside. - In the same pot, sauté the garlic until lightly golden and fragrant. Add onions and cook until softened. - Return the pork to the pot, pour in the pork broth. Add the soy sauce, vinegar, green chilies, bay leaves, peppercorns, and palm sugar.  - Cover and let simmer on medium heat for 5-10 mins **don’t mix to allow vinegar to cook.  - Turn to low heat for 1–2 hours, until the pork is tender and the sauce has reduced. you want it to be almost swimming in its own fat like a confit - Optional: If serving with eggs, add the soft boiled eggs 2-3 mins before serving to retain jammyness - Serve over hot rice, topped with crispy garlic and leeks, and a hard-boiled egg on the side. Enjoy. #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood #asmr #cookingasmr #pinoyfood
zh: 菲律宾猪肉阿斗波 | 菲律宾美食圣经 – 第1集 我对于最具标志性的菲律宾菜肴之一——猪肉阿斗波的诠释！该系列将呈现所有菲律宾菜肴及其各种变化。把这当作你的菲律宾美食指南。评论你想看的下道菜！ 食材： 猪肉阿斗波 - 1.2公斤猪五花肉（或自选部位） - 15–20瓣大蒜，切碎（用量可调整——越多越受欢迎） - 1个洋葱，切碎 - 500毫升猪肉高汤 - 190毫升酱油 - 100毫升甘蔗醋 - 3根长绿辣椒 - 4片月桂叶 - 1汤匙整粒黑胡椒 - 30克椰糖，切碎（甜度可调整） - 油，用于煎炸 配料 - 切碎的青蒜叶 - 香脆蒜粒 - 水煮蛋 步骤 - 将猪肉煎至各面浅黄，盛出备用。 - 同一锅中，将大蒜炒至浅金色并散发香味。加入洋葱，炒至变软。 - 将猪肉放回锅中，倒入猪肉高汤。加入酱油、醋、绿辣椒、月桂叶、黑胡椒和椰糖。 - 盖上盖子，中火炖煮5-10分钟。**不要搅拌，让醋充分烹煮。 - 转小火煮1–2小时，直至猪肉软烂，酱汁收浓。理想状态是猪肉几乎像油封一样浸在自身的油脂中。 - 可选：如果配鸡蛋，在出锅前2-3分钟加入溏心蛋，以保持溏心状态。 - 盛在热米饭上，顶部放上香脆蒜粒和青蒜，旁边配一颗全熟水煮蛋。享用。

d: Recipes Jordan Should Know Ep 8 | Filipino Spaghetti 🇵🇭🍝 RECIPE * 1 lb spaghetti noodles * Water, for boiling * Salt, for pasta water * 1 lb lean ground beef * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 medium onion, diced * 5 Filipino red hotdogs, sliced * 24 oz Filipino-style spaghetti sauce, or regular spaghetti sauce * 1 cup banana ketchup * ½–1 can condensed milk, adjusted to taste * Ground black pepper, to taste * Fish sauce, to taste * Cheddar cheese, for topping Directions 1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the spaghetti and cook until al dente. Drain and set aside. 2. Sauté the garlic and onion until fragrant and softened. Add the ground beef and cook until browned. 3. Season with fish sauce and black pepper to taste. 4. Add the sliced Filipino red hotdogs and cook for a few minutes. 5. Add the Filipino-style spaghetti sauce, or regular spaghetti sauce, and banana ketchup. Stir to combine. 6. Add ½ can condensed milk, then taste and add more as needed for your preferred sweetness. 7. Pour the sauce over the cooked pasta and mix until well coated. 8. Serve topped with cheddar cheese. #cooking #recipes #filipinofood
zh: 乔丹该懂的食谱 第8集 | 菲律宾意面 食谱 * 1磅意面 * 水，用于煮沸 * 盐，用于煮面水 * 1磅瘦牛肉馅 * 4瓣大蒜，切碎 * 1个中等洋葱，切丁 * 5根菲律宾红热狗，切片 * 24盎司菲律宾风味意面酱，或普通意面酱 * 1杯香蕉番茄酱 * ½–1罐炼乳，根据口味调整 * 黑胡椒粉，适量 * 鱼露，适量 * 切达奶酪，用于顶部装饰 步骤 1. 将一大锅加盐的水煮沸。加入意面，煮至弹牙。沥干备用。 2. 将大蒜和洋葱炒香至变软。加入牛肉馅，炒至变黄。 3. 用鱼露和黑胡椒调味。 4. 加入切片的菲律宾红热狗，翻炒几分钟。 5. 加入菲律宾风味意面酱或普通意面酱，以及香蕉番茄酱。搅拌均匀。 6. 加入半罐炼乳，品尝后根据需要添加更多以达到你喜欢的甜度。 7. 将酱汁倒在煮好的意面上，拌匀至充分裹上酱汁。 8. 盛盘，顶部撒上切达奶酪。

d: 🇵🇭 Beef Salpicao | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 12 My take on a delicious FIlipino-Spanish dish usually made with tender beef cubes cooked in garlic, butter and Worcestershire sauce — but with extra garlic flavor!  * this recipe is only a guideline. most ingredients are just estimates so taste and adjust with your ❤️ INGREDIENTS: Beef salpicao: - 500g ribeye steak (or any cut of steak of your choice) - 300g of button mushrooms - Salt and pepper to taste - Oil for frying - 1/4 block of butter - 15-20 cloves of garlic, minced - 3 tbsp of Worcestershire sauce  - 1  tbsp of oyster sauce  - 2 tbsp of paprika  Garlic confit: - 300g of peeled garlic cloves - Olive Oil to cover Garnish: - parsley - crunchy garlic - pickled peppers INSTRUCTIONS: - Start by seasoning your steak and grilling until medium rare. Slice them into bite sized chunks and set aside for later - Slice button mushrooms. In a pan , add oil and/or butter, sauté the button mushrooms until they get deeper in color. Season with salt and pepper.  - Add minced garlic to a hot pan with oil and butter, and saute unti fragrant. Add back your steak and mushroom and add Worcestershire sauce, oyster sauce, paprika and black pepper. - To make it extra garlicky, we’re adding some garlic confit. To make it, simply add peeled garlic to a pot, cover with oil, and cook low and slow until the cloves are soft and golden. - Serve with garlic rice and enjoy! #CookingASMR #ASMR # FilipinoFood #pinoyfood
zh: 菲律宾牛肉萨尔皮考 | 菲律宾美食圣经 第12集 我对这道美味菲式西班牙菜的诠释，通常用嫩牛肉块、大蒜、黄油和伍斯特酱烹制——但额外增加了蒜香！ * 此食谱仅为指南。大多数食材用量为估算值，请根据个人喜好品尝调整。 食材： 牛肉萨尔皮考： - 500克肋眼牛排（或任何你选择的牛排部位） - 300克白蘑菇 - 盐和胡椒，适量 - 油，用于煎炸 - 1/4块黄油 - 15-20瓣大蒜，切碎 - 3汤匙伍斯特酱 - 1汤匙蚝油 - 2汤匙红椒粉 油封大蒜： - 300克去皮蒜瓣 - 橄榄油，足以没过蒜瓣 装饰： - 欧芹 - 脆蒜粒 - 腌辣椒 步骤： - 先将牛排调味，烤至三分熟。切成一口大小的块，备用。 - 白蘑菇切片。平底锅中加入油和/或黄油，炒白蘑菇至颜色变深。用盐和胡椒调味。 - 在热锅中加油和黄油，加入蒜末炒香。放回牛排和蘑菇，加入伍斯特酱、蚝油、红椒粉和黑胡椒。 - 为增加蒜香，我们加入油封大蒜。制作方法：将去皮蒜瓣放入锅中，用油没过，小火慢煮至蒜瓣变软呈金色。 - 搭配蒜香米饭享用！ 菲律宾美食

🇵🇭 La Paz Batchoy | Soups So Good It Can Cure Any Sickness Ep. 31 My take on one of the Philippines most beloved noodle soups. Originating from the La Paz  district of Iloilo CIty it grew from a humble market meal into one of Iloilo’s most recognizable dishes! It’s rich, garlicky and delicious and probably one of my favorite noodle soups of all time *most ingredients are estimates since I cook and season mostly by feel so taste and season as you cook to fit your taste! :) INGREDIENTS: Kaldo / Broth: - 2 kg pork bones - 2 kg beef marrow bones - 1kg pork shoulder, kasim, or pork belly - 2 onions, roughly chopped - 4 heads garlic, halved - 2 green onion, roughly chopped - 1 tbsp peppercorns - water as needed - 1/4 cup ginamos or to taste - Salt/patis, to taste - 2-3 tsp sugar, optional Meat Toppings: - pork liver, sliced - Cooked pork shoulder, sliced Noodles & Toppings: - miki/egg noodles - crushed chicharon -  toasted garlic - spring onions - Egg yolk - Roasted Bone marrow INSTRUCTIONS: - add your pork bones and beef marrow bones to a large pot and blanch for 10 minutes. Discard water and rinse the bones before adding them back into the pot with the onions, garlic, leek, and peppercorns. Fill w/ water and simmer for 8 hours, or overnight for the best results. - Once the stock is ready, remove bones, add guinamos to a strainer lined optionally with cheese cloth and strain soup for a silkier texture. add soup back to pot -  add your pork shoulder and simmer for around 45 minutes - In a separate pot, sauté some garlic until lightly toasted before adding your broth. Season with more guinamos if needed, sugar, and fish sauce to taste. Optionally you can blend this broth along with bone marrow if you want an extra rich soup. - Add the pork liver to the reserved broth and gently simmer until fully cooked through. Avoid overcooking it so the liver stays tender. Remove and slice let it rest before slicing thinly along with pork shoulder. - Slice cooked pork and liver. - Serve with noodles, hot broth, sliced pork/ and liver, crispy garlic, spring onions scallions, crushed chicharon, an egg yolk, and ea piece of bone marrow. Enjoy! #Soups #Soup #asmr #asmrcooking

🇵🇭 Pork Binagoongan | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 11 One of the more underrated but S tier Filipino dishes!! Usually made with pork simmered in “bagoong alamang”, or fermented shrimp paste - best served with rice, sometimes with eggplant or green mango on the side. Its savory, funky, and slightly sweet, with tons of umami 💡Pro tip: adjust depending on your bagoong. Not all bagoong tastes the same — some are saltier, milder, or sweeter — so taste as you go and balance it out with sugar, vinegar, and tomatoes. INGREDIENTS: Binagoongan: - 1.5 kg pork ribs, blanched (you can use pork belly or cut of choice) - 5-6 tbsp bagoong guisado - 1 large onion, diced - 15-20 cloves garlic, sliced - 4 long green chilies, sliced - 350g tomatoes, sliced - 1/3 cup cane vinegar - 1/3 cup brown sugar - 1/4 cup soy sauce - Water as needed - Black pepper, to taste Bagoong Guisado: - 400g shrimp paste (alamang) - 25-30 cloves garlic - 7-10 red chilies - 6-7 shallots - 400g tomatoes, diced - 1/4 cup vinegar - 1/3 cup brown sugar Ensaladang Mangga: - Green mango - Red onion - Cilantro - Tomato - Lime - Salt - Pepper INSTRUCTIONS:  - Blanch pork for 10 minutes, before straining and rinsing. Set aside. - To make the bagoong start by blitzing onions or shallots, garlic, and red chilies in a processor.  Add to cold pan with oil and cook until garlic is slightly oasted add tomatoes, alamang, sugar and vinegar. Allow this to simmer until the oil comes out and the tomatoes are jammy. - For the binagoongan start by sauteing onions, garlic, and chilies. add back your meat and all other ingredients listed under  “Binagoongan” and simmer for 40mins-1hr or until tender - In the meantime you can pair this with a fresh ensalada by combining all ingredients under “ensalada”. - Serve and enjoy! #CookingASMR #ASMR #FilipinoFood #pinoyfood

d: 🇵🇭🍗 Max’s Style Fried Chicken INGREDIENTS: *some measurements may be estimates only so season and adjust to your liking 🙏🫶 Chicken Marinade: - 6pcs chicken leg quarter - 1/4 cup patis - 1/4 cup ml of calamansi - 10 cloves of garlic, minced Chicken blanching liquid: - 3 onions, chopped - 3 heads garlic, halved - 1 stalk of cilantro/wansoy - ¼ cup of calamansi juice - 3-4 bay leaves  - ¼ cup of peppercorn - ¼ cup of patis - 1-2 sachets of Maggi Magic Sarap - marinating liquid - Water as needed Chicken Drying: - 1 sachet of Maggi Magic Sarap - 1 tsp of baking powder Chicken Frying: - Oil as needed Sweet Potato Fries: - 6 sweet potatoes, fries cut - Water as needed - ⅓ cup of white vinegar - 1/4 cup of flour - ¼ cup of cornstarch - ¼ cup of rice flour - 1 tsp of baking powder - 1 tsp of baking soda - Water from soaking - Oil Dipping: - Banana Ketchup - Worcestershire sauce INSTRUCTIONS - Marinate the chicken w/ all ingredients under “marinade”. Set aside for 2hrs-overnight. - Transfer the chicken to a pot and add all the ingredients under “Chicken Boiling Liquid.” Pour in enough water to cover most of the chicken, low simmer for around 15 mins. - Combine the Maggi Magic Sarap and baking powder, then season the chicken evenly. dry in fridge overnight uncovered. - Soak sweet potatoes in water and vinegar. Reserve some soaking water before draining. Combine the potatoes, flour, cornstarch, rice flour, baking powder, and baking soda. add a little reserved soaking liquid to create a light batter. deep fry at 165°C for 4-5mins or until crisp. - For the dipping sauce, combine the banana ketchup and Worcestershire sauce. - Serve fried chicken with rice, sweet potato fries, and dipping sauce. Enjoy! #CookwithMagic #cookingasmr #asmr

d: Creamy Garlic & Herb Chicken! Easy, flavorful, and everything comes together in ONE pan! No canned cream soups needed, the creamy gravy cooks right along with the chicken, so once it comes out of the oven, it’s already thick, flavorful, and ready to spoon right on top. And because I couldn’t decide between rice or mashed potatoes with all that delicious gravy, I made BOTH. Why choose when you don’t have to? Save this one for an easy, comforting dinner!  10 thighs & drumsticks  2 tsp rotisserie chicken seasoning  1 tsp Tony’s Creole  1 1/2 tsp smoked paprika  2 tsp roasted garlic powder  1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp sazon tropical  1/2 tsp Italian & herb seasoning  1 1/2 tsp onion powder  1 tbsp garlic paste Thyme Rosemary  8-10 garlic cloves  Red pepper, sliced  Onion, sliced  Creamy Gravy  1 1/2 cup Better Than Bouillon Roasted Chicken, prepared  1 cup heavy whipping cream  Cornstarch slurry(1 1/2 tbsp cornstarch + 1 1/2 tbsp cold water  Rotisserie chicken seasoning, to taste Smoked paprika, to taste  *Bake on 375°F covered for 35 minutes *Baste chicken and bake uncovered for 25-35 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 165°F or higher.  *Option: Broil for 2-3 minutes for crispier skin  #Foodie #food #chicken #cooking #dinner

d: Garlic parmesan cheeseburger bombs 🍔  For all of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store! Save this recipe and thank me later 😌 RECIPE ⬇️ * 1 lb 80/20 ground beef * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder  * 2 tsp Worcestershire  * Minced garlic  * Salt & pepper to taste  * Optional add-ins: caramelized onions, bacon * Mild cheddar, large cubes * Shredded mozzarella  * 1 can biscuit dough (Pillsbury original flakey layers, red top) * 1 egg, whisked (for egg wash) * Parmesan  Garlic butter: * 3 tbs salted butter, melted * 2 cloves garlic, finely minced * Dried or fresh parsley 1. Cook the ground beef on medium heat. Once browned, add minced garlic and all the seasonings. Stir for a minute. Set aside.  2. Preheat oven to 375F 3. Take each biscuit and stretch it into a 5 inch circle. Add 2 spoonfuls of seasoned beef, some mozzarella, and a cube of cheese in the middle.  4. Fold the dough around the filling and pinch the edges tightly to seal. Pull it into a tight ball. Rest 5 min. 5. Place them seam side down on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Brush a thin layer of egg wash and sprinkle fresh grated parmesan. 6. Bake at 375F for 15-18 min until deeply golden. 7. Brush on garlic butter and sprinkle more parmesan. Serve immediately. #cheeseburgers #garlicparmesan #garlicknots #dinneridea #cheapmeals

d: Recipe Name Cheesy Crunchy Beef Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 2. 8 hard taco shells 3. 1 tbsp olive oil 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 2 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 7. 1/2 cup water 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded 10. 1/2 cup heavy cream 11. 2 oz cream cheese, softened 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp chili powder 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 1 diced tomato 16. 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro Recipe 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro. 11. Serve immediately while the shells stay crispy. Follow for more delicious recipes!

d: This ain’t your average mac and cheese🔥 Creamy gochujang mac & cheese topped with juicy steak and buttery shrimp, all made in a heart pan💓  The cream cheese makes it extra velvety, while the gochujang cuts through the richness with just the right amount of heat🔥 Creamy gochujang mac and cheese is my love language🍝✨Trust me—you’ll be obsessed after the first bite😍 📍Share with your pasta bestie & save this recipe for your next craving💗 ✨ Hailey’s Gochujang Cream Cheese Mac & Cheese 📝 Ingredients * 4oz elbow macaroni * 3 slices American cheese * 1 slice Colby Jack cheese * 2 tbsp cream cheese * ½–1 tbsp gochujang  * 1 cup heavy cream * 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese * ½ cup shredded mozzarella cheese * 1 tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp onion powder * ¼ tsp paprika * ¼ tsp black pepper * Salt * Grilled shrimp * Sliced steak * Parsley ⸻ 👩‍🍳 Instructions 1. Cook the macaroni until al dente. Reserve about ½ cup of the pasta water, then drain. 2. Over low heat, add the American cheese, Colby Jack cheese, cream cheese, and gochujang to a pan. Add the garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Stir until the cheeses are fully melted and the mixture is smooth. 3. Pour in the heavy cream and add the cooked macaroni. Stir until the pasta is evenly coated. 4. Add ½ cup of the shredded cheddar and ¼ cup of the mozzarella, stirring until melted and silky. If the sauce is too thick, loosen it with a splash of the reserved pasta water. 5. Sprinkle the remaining shredded cheddar and mozzarella over the top. Cover and cook for about 1 minute, or until the cheese is melted. 6. Top with grilled shrimp or sliced steak, then garnish with chopped parsley and freshly cracked black pepper. 💡 Tip * American cheese and cream cheese are the secret to an ultra-smooth, velvety sauce. * Start with ½ tablespoon of gochujang for a milder kick, or use 1 tablespoon if you like it spicier. * The gochujang balances the richness of the cheese, making every bite creamy without feeling too heavy. * Taste and adjust the salt at the end, since the cheese and gochujang already add plenty of seasoning. #asmrfood #mukbang #gochujangmacandcheese #koreanpasta #fyp

d: Chicken Alfredo Lasagna Rolls  Ingredients Chicken * 3–4 chicken breasts, cubed * ½ tsp salt * ½ tsp pepper * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp paprika * 1 tsp oregano * 1 tbsp avocado oil * Shredded mozzarella * 6–8 lasagna sheets Spinach & Ricotta Filling * 1 yellow onion, chopped * 20 cloves garlic, minced * Olive oil * 1 lbs spinach * 1 cup ricotta * 1 egg * 1 cup grated Parmesan Alfredo Sauce * 4–5 cloves garlic, minced * 4 oz cream cheese * 2½ tbsp chicken broth * 1 cup heavy cream * ½ cup pasta water * 1 tsp oregano * ½ tsp paprika * ⅓ cup Parmesan Directions 1. Cook lasagna sheets until al dente and save the pasta water. 2. Season and cook cubed chicken in oil until fully cooked. Remove and set aside. 3. In the same pan, sauté onion and garlic. Add spinach and cook until wilted. Remove from heat and mix in ricotta, egg, and Parmesan. 4. Make the Alfredo in the same pan: sauté garlic, melt in cream cheese, then add broth, heavy cream, oregano, and paprika. Stir in Parmesan and pasta water until creamy. 5. Assemble: Spread a little Alfredo over each noodle, then add spinach mixture, chicken, and mozzarella. Roll up and place in a baking dish. 6. Pour remaining Alfredo over the rolls and top with mozzarella. 7. Cover and bake at 400°F for 15–20 minutes. Uncover and broil for a few minutes until golden and bubbly. #alfredo #chickenalfredo #lasagna #baked #creamy @Le Creuset

d: This one is a super easy dinner recipe the whole family enjoys! Using rotisserie chicken makes this recipe even easier.  I’ll be posting easy dinners every day for the month of August! Make sure to let me know what meals would be helpful to your family.  Chicken Bacon Ranch Pasta Bake INGREDIENTS  1 lb of Cellentani Pasta  1 lb cooked chicken (rotisserie chicken) 15 oz jar of Alfredo Sauce 1 Ranch seasoning packet  1 cup of shredded cheddar cheese 1 1/2 cups of shredded mozzarella cheese 6 pieces of cooked and crumbled bacon Parsley INSTRUCTIONS  Cook at least 6 pieces of bacon and chop into small pieces. Boil one pound of pasta according to the directions on the package. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray and set aside. Pour the cooked pasta into the bottom of the baking dish. Add about 1 lb of rotisserie chicken, one jar of Alfredo sauce, and a ranch seasoning packet. Add some of the mozzarella, cheddar cheese, and some of the bacon and stir everything together well.  Top with a little bit more cheddar cheese, mozzarella cheese, and crumbled bacon. Bake at 375 degrees F for about 15-20 minutes. Serve and enjoy! #easyrecipes #easydinners #chicken

d: Apple Pie Cinnamon Rolls 🍎💛🥰 the most moist and tender apple pie cinnamon rolls! Now that apple picking is coming up soon, this recipe is perfect to ring in the fall season!  Makes 9 rolls. I used a 9x9 inch square pan. Ingredients For the Dough: * 180g milk whole is best * 1 1/8 teaspoons (6 grams) active dry yeast  * 1 teaspoon honey * 1 large egg plus 1 large egg yolk, room temperature * 75g sugar * ½ teaspoon salt * 410g bread flour plus extra for rolling * 60g butter room temperature  For the Cinnamon Sugar Filling: * 64g Unsalted butter, softened * 95g Brown sugar * 2 tsp Ground cinnamon * 1/8 tsp Ground nutmeg For the Apple Pie Filling/Topping (Use only 350-400g for the filling, the remaining filling is for the topping after the rolls are baked): * 650g apples (about 3-4 apples), peel cored and small diced * 3 tbsp butter  * Juice of 1 lemon  * 110g brown sugar, packed  * 1/4 tsp salt * 2 teaspoon cinnamon * Cornstarch slurry: 2 1/2 tsp cornstarch plus 2 1/2 tsp water Classic cream cheese icing: * 56g unsalted butter, room temperature  * 4 oz cream cheese, room temperature * 1/2 tsp cinnamon  * 2-3 tbsp heavy cream or milk * 100g icing sugar  After the rolls have proofed, pour about 1/4 cup heavy cream over the rolls and bake at 350 for 27-30 minutes. Or until the cinnamon rolls have fully baked.  Full detailed recipe also posted on my website. Link in bio or the link is here: https://littlebbanghouse.com/327/apple-pie-cinnamon-rolls/ #applepie #cinnamonroll #fallbaking #sweettreats #bakingrecipe

d: Recipe Name Steak Fajita Tray Bake Ingredients 1. 2 lbs flank steak, sliced 2. 3 bell peppers, sliced 3. 1 large onion, sliced 4. 2 tbsp olive oil 5. 1 tbsp chili powder 6. 1 tsp paprika 7. 1 tsp garlic powder 8. 1 tsp cumin 9. 1 tsp salt 10. 1/2 tsp black pepper 11. Warm tortillas for serving Recipe 1. Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). 2. Place sliced peppers in a large tray. 3. Add sliced onion. 4. Drizzle vegetables with olive oil. 5. Season with chili powder and paprika. 6. Add garlic powder and cumin. 7. Toss vegetables to coat evenly. 8. Arrange sliced steak on top. 9. Season steak with salt and pepper. 10. d: Would you actually eat this street food? 😳 In this wild street food compilation, we explore some of the most unbelievable street food scenes from around the world. From massive woks full of noodles to busy street vendors cooking huge portions right in front of customers, this video shows the reality of street food markets and street food cooking that millions of people enjoy every day. Street food is famous for its bold flavors, fast cooking, and incredible variety. In many countries, street vendors prepare delicious meals in giant pans, sizzling grills, and steaming pots right on the street. But sometimes the cooking conditions can look a little questionable… which raises the big question — would you actually eat this street food? 🍜🔥 This street food video shows everything from huge noodle stir-fries and sizzling wok cooking to intense street kitchen action where vendors prepare food quickly for long lines of hungry customers. Street food markets are full of energy, heat, flames, and nonstop cooking that makes these food scenes fascinating to watch. Whether you love street food, enjoy food documentaries, or just want to see some unbelievable cooking moments, this street food compilation will definitely make you think twice. Some of these street food scenes look delicious… while others might make you wonder if you would really try it! 🤯 Let us know in the comments — would YOU eat this street food? 👇  #streetfood​ #shorts​ #food​

d: Here is my One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta Dinner 🤤🍝 full recipe on my website.  Crispy on the outside, juicy and full of flavor chicken over a rich, creamy, cheesy pasta. Easy comfort food made in one pot! No mess no stress dinner 😊 One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta:  Ingredients Chicken 2 chicken breasts 1 tbsp olive oil 1–2 tbsp butter 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder Salt and black pepper, to taste Pasta & Sauce 8 oz dry rigatoni 24 oz heavy cream 24 oz chicken broth (add more if needed) 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1–2 cups shredded cheese of your choice (I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar) Optional Garnish Fresh parsley, chopped Grated Parmesan cheese Red pepper flakes Instructions Season the chicken: Coat the chicken breasts with olive oil, Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, sweet paprika, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Let the chicken marinate in the refrigerator for 15–30 minutes for the best flavor. Cook the chicken: Heat a large pot or skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for about 2–3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove the chicken from the pan and let it rest. Cook the pasta: In the same pot, add the rigatoni, heavy cream, chicken broth, 1–2 tbsp butter, and seasonings. Stir everything together, cover, and let the pasta simmer until al dente, stirring occasionally. Add more broth or cream if needed while the pasta cooks. Add the cheese: Once the pasta is cooked, add your shredded cheese and stir until melted and creamy. I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar, but feel free to use whatever cheese you have in the fridge. Finish and serve: Slice the rested chicken and place it on top of the creamy pasta. Garnish with fresh parsley, Parmesan cheese, or red pepper flakes if desired. #easyrecipe  #pasta #chicken #familydinner #onepot

d: One pot chicken fajita rice skillet smothered in queso 🤤 The easiest weeknight dinner and one of those recipes the whole family will love. Save this one for your next easy dinner! One-Pot Chicken Fajita Rice Skillet Recipe  Ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 onion, sliced 3 bell peppers, sliced into strips yellow, red & green 2 chicken breasts, sliced into strips 1 packet fajita seasoning 1 tablespoon garlic 1 can Rotel, undrained 1 cup rice, washed  1 teaspoon tomato bouillon 2 cups chicken broth Queso: 1 can green chiles 1 small can evaporated milk (5 oz) ½ pound white American cheese slices, from the deli Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and bell peppers and cook until softened. Add the sliced chicken and fajita seasoning. Stir to coat everything and cook until the chicken is fully cooked through. Add the garlic and Rotel. Stir to combine. Add the rice, chicken broth, and tomato bouillon. Stir everything together. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover and cook for 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed. While the rice cooks, make the queso. Add the evaporated milk, green chiles, and the white American cheese to a small saucepan over low heat. Stir until the cheese is completely melted and the queso is smooth. Fluff the rice, then pour the queso evenly over the top. Serve hot. #OnePotMeals #DinnerIdeas #EasyRecipe #WeeknightDinner #MealIdeas

d: Lemon garlic salmon pasta ✨🍋 Ingredients  Salmon - 4 salmon fillets - 1 tsp kinder’s lemon garlic butter seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic powder  - 1 tsp paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - Salt and pepper to taste - 1 tbsp butter - 1 tbsp avocado oil  - 14 oz fettuccine  Cream sauce - 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream - 1/4 cup lemon juice - 1/4 cup pasta water - 1 lemon, zested - 3 tbsp butter  - 6 garlic cloves, minced - 2 shallot, finely chopped  - 1 cup Parmesan cheese  - 1 heaping tsp garlic powder  - 1 heaping tsp kinders lemon garlic butter sesoning - 1 tsp basil - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 - 1/2 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions - Bring a large pot of well-salted water to a boil. - Cook fettuccine according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain and set aside. - Pat salmon filets dry. - Rub with avocado oil, then season with paprika, garlic powder, oregano, kinders lemon garlic butter seasoning, salt, and pepper. - Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and butter. Sear salmon for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through, basting with the pan drippings. Remove and set aside. - In the same skillet, reduce heat to medium. Add butter and let melt. Sauté shallot for about 3 minutes until softened, then add garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant. - Stir in lemon juice and heavy cream. Let simmer for 2–3 minutes until slightly thickened, then add lemon zest. - Add seasonings and freshly grated Parmesan. Stir until smooth. Pour in reserved pasta water and mix until the sauce is well combined. Taste and adjust salt and pepper as needed. - Add cooked pasta to the skillet and toss until evenly coated in the sauce. - Garnish with fresh parsley and serve alongside the salmon. • • • #Recipe #DinnerIdeas #pasta #salmonrecipe #recipeideas

d: Chicken alfredo tacos 🌮  For the chicken 1 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  1/2 tsp Italian seasoning  2 tbsp lemon juice  2 tbsp oil for marinating + more for cooking For the Alfredo sauce: 2 tbsp butter 1 tbsp all purpose flour  2 cloves fresh garlic, minced  1 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream Salt to taste  1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1/2 cup milk 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese, freshly grated  To assemble  15-16 mini tacos 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for lightly frying the tacos 1/4 cup parsley, freshly chopped for garnish  Method  Marinate the chicken with salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, Italian seasoning, lemon juice, and oil for 20–30 minutes. Cook until golden and set aside. In the same pan, melt the butter and sauté the garlic. Whisk in the flour, then add the heavy cream and milk. Season with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder. Simmer until slightly thickened, then stir in the Parmesan until smooth.  Add the cooked chicken to half of the sauce and toss to coat. Reserve half for later . Fill each tortilla with mozzarella, the chicken Alfredo mixture, and a little more mozzarella. Fold and pan-fry until golden and crispy on both sides. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve with extra Alfredo sauce for dipping. #recipe #tacos #alfredochicken

d: Recipe Name: Slow Cooker Creamy Garlic Parmesan Pork Chops Ingredients 1. 4 bone-in pork chops 2. 1 tsp salt 3. 1/2 tsp black pepper 4. 1 tsp garlic powder 5. 1 tsp onion powder 6. 1 tbsp olive oil 7. 3 tbsp butter 8. 4 cloves garlic, minced 9. 1 cup chicken broth 10. 1 cup heavy cream 11. 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 13. 1/2 tsp paprika 14. 1 tbsp cornstarch 15. 2 tbsp water 16. 2 tbsp chopped parsley Recipe 1. Pat the pork chops dry with paper towels. 2. Season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika. 3. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Sear the pork chops for 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown. 5. Transfer the pork chops to a slow cooker. 6. In the same skillet, melt butter and sauté the garlic for 30 seconds. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and scrape up any browned bits from the pan. 8. Stir in the heavy cream, Parmesan cheese, and Italian seasoning. 9. Pour the creamy mixture over the pork chops in the slow cooker. 10. Cover and cook on LOW for 5–6 hours or HIGH for 2½–3 hours. 11. Mix cornstarch and water in a small bowl until smooth. 12. Stir the slurry into the slow cooker during the last 20 minutes of cooking. 13. Let the sauce thicken while the pork chops finish cooking. 14. Spoon the creamy garlic Parmesan sauce over the pork chops. 15. Garnish with fresh parsley before serving. 16. Serve hot with mashed potatoes, rice, or roasted vegetables. d: Crunchy Orc Gyoza🥟  (Episode 1 Season 2) Ingredients 225 g ground pork  50 g cabbage, finely chopped 10 g chives, minced 2.5 g ginger paste (½ tsp) 1.25 g garlic paste (¼ tsp) ½ tbsp soy sauce ½ tbsp sake ¼ tsp chicken broth powder ½ tsp sesame oil Salt and pepper to taste 15–20 gyoza wrappers For cooking: A drizzle of cooking oil 2.5 g flour (about ½ tsp) 60 ml water ½ tsp sesame oil (for finishing) Instructions Prepare the filling – In a bowl, mix ground pork, cabbage, chives, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, sake, chicken broth powder, sesame oil, salt, and pepper. Stir until well combined and slightly sticky. Assemble the gyoza – Place a small spoonful of filling in the center of each wrapper. Moisten the edge with water, fold, and pleat the top to seal. Pan-fry – Heat a bit of oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat. Add the gyoza flat-side down and cook until the bottoms are golden brown. Steam-fry – Mix the flour and water, then pour into the pan. Cover with a lid and steam for 5–6 minutes until the water evaporates. Crisp & finish – Remove the lid, drizzle with ½ tsp sesame oil, and let the bottoms crisp up again. Serve hot – Pair with dipping sauce (soy sauce + vinegar + chili oil).   #campfirecooking #CampfireCookinginAnotherWorld #animefood #animecooking

d: Loaded Italian Deli Meat Stromboli Ingredients 1. Pizza Dough – 1 lb 2. Pepperoni – 6 oz, thinly sliced 3. Deli Ham – 6 oz, thinly sliced 4. Salami – 6 oz, thinly sliced 5. Provolone Cheese – 6 oz, sliced 6. Mozzarella Cheese – 2 cups, shredded 7. Parmesan Cheese – 1/2 cup, finely grated 8. Pizza Sauce – 1 1/2 cups 9. Garlic – 3 cloves, minced 10. Unsalted Butter – 3 tbsp, melted 11. Italian Seasoning – 2 tsp 12. Dried Oregano – 1 tsp 13. Red Pepper Flakes – 1/2 tsp 14. Salt – 1/2 tsp 15. Black Pepper – 1/2 tsp 16. Fresh Parsley – 2 tbsp, finely chopped 17. Egg – 1 large, beaten 18. Olive Oil – 1 tbsp Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Lightly brush the parchment with the olive oil. 2. In a small bowl, combine the melted butter, minced garlic, Italian seasoning, oregano, red pepper flakes, salt, black pepper, and 1 tablespoon of the fresh parsley. Set the garlic-herb butter aside. 3. Lightly flour a work surface and roll the pizza dough into a large rectangle approximately 12 by 18 inches, keeping the thickness even from edge to edge. 4. Brush a thin layer of the garlic-herb butter over the dough, leaving about a 1-inch border around all sides so the filling stays contained while rolling. 5. Spread 1 cup of pizza sauce over the dough, keeping the sauce inside the border. Sprinkle 1 cup of shredded mozzarella and 1/4 cup of Parmesan evenly over the sauce. 6. Layer the sliced ham, salami, and pepperoni evenly over the cheese. Arrange the meats in overlapping layers so every slice of the finished stromboli contains a generous amount of filling. 7. Add the sliced provolone over the deli meats, then sprinkle the remaining mozzarella and Parmesan over the top. 8. Starting from one long edge, roll the dough tightly over the filling, continuing to roll until you reach the opposite edge. Pinch the seam firmly closed and tuck both ends underneath. 9. Carefully transfer the stromboli seam-side down onto the prepared baking sheet. Brush the entire surface with the beaten egg for a glossy golden crust. 10. Use a sharp knife to cut 5 to 7 shallow diagonal slits across the top of the dough. These vents allow steam to escape while giving the finished stromboli its classic bakery-style appearance. 11. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, rotating the baking sheet halfway through, until the crust is puffed, deeply golden, and crisp and the cheese inside is completely melted. 12. Remove the stromboli from the oven and immediately brush the hot crust with the remaining garlic-herb butter. Sprinkle the remaining fresh parsley over the top. 13. Let the stromboli rest for 10 to 15 minutes before slicing so the melted cheese and meat filling can settle instead of spilling out when cut. 14. Slice into thick pieces and serve warm with the remaining 1/2 cup of pizza sauce heated for dipping. Serve with a simple Italian salad, roasted vegetables, or crispy potato wedges. d: BUN BO HUE aka my favorite food EVER 🥢 #bunbohue #vietnamesefood #noodles #easyrecipe #asmr  Bun Bo Hue Broth - Flank steak - Parboiled beef bones - Lemongrass - Pineapple - Ginger - Daikon - Shallot - Yellow onion - Water - Salt - Chicken bouillon - Mushroom bouillon - Fish sauce - Shrimp paste - Saté Parboil the flank steak and beef bones for 5–10 minutes, then rinse well. Add to a large stock pot with slightly smashed lemongrass, pineapple, ginger, daikon, shallot, onion, and a few spoonfuls of salt. Cover with water, bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 1 hour, continuously skimming the scum from the top. Remove the flank steak and set aside to cool, then add the saté and simmer the broth for another 5 hours. Remove the onion, shallot, and ginger (I keep the daikon for my bowls) and season with chicken bouillon, mushroom bouillon, fish sauce, and shrimp paste. Taste and adjust to your preference. Saté - Shallot - Garlic - Lemongrass - Avocado oil - BBH seasoning - Red pepper flakes - Sugar - Shrimp paste - Fish sauce Sauté finely minced shallot, garlic, and lemongrass in avocado oil for about 5 minutes, until slightly golden and fragrant. Add a packet of BBH seasoning and red pepper flakes and sauté for another 2 minutes. Add half to the broth and reserve the other half for garnish. To the reserved saté, add a small ladle of broth, sugar, shrimp paste, and fish sauce, then sauté for another couple minutes. Bowl - Thick rice vermicelli - Cabbage - Bean sprouts - Sliced flank steak - Yellow onion - Green onion - Cilantro - Lime - Saté I like to prep all my toppings ahead of time and store them in glass containers for easy assembly throughout the week. Rinse and dry the cabbage and bean sprouts well, then store in a paper towel-lined container. Keep the sliced flank steak separate. For the noodles, boil for 10–15 minutes depending on thickness, then turn off the heat, cover, and let sit for another 10–15 minutes. Strain and rinse very well to remove excess starch, then let dry for about 15 minutes before assembling.

d: For 8 yuan ($1 USD) in China, I got a full kilogram of Jiang Xiang Bing  (酱香饼). The dough is flattened so wide that it folds onto itself while  baking, creating layers of texture. After five minutes in the oven, a  sweet fermented wheat sauce is brushed over the top. The folds soak up  the sauce, locking in extra flavor. Sesame seeds and scallions are  sprinkled as the finishing touch. The result is a fluffy, chewy bread  with a perfect balance of sweet and savory.   #China #Food #Travel #ChineseFood #ChinaFood #StreetFood
zh: 在中国花8元人民币，我买到了一整公斤的酱香饼。面团在烤制时摊得很宽，以至于折叠起来，形成了层层质感。出炉后刷上甜面酱，撒上芝麻和葱花。
